verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5070 family page says RTX AI PCs get GPU-optimized SDKs and models across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch and other inference backends. It also promises running the latest AI models locally, and the CUDA Toolkit supplies the underlying compute stack. That is a glancing, marketing-level LLM inference story rather than a documented one for this part. missing for 10: documentation of FP8/FP4 low-precision support on this GPU, explicit TensorRT-LLM, vLLM or llama.cpp support for the 5070 Ti, any LLM throughput or VRAM-fit guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM inference.
